newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada defense official charged in child porn case.
newsitem.headline: Canada defense official charged in child porn case.

text.p: A scientist at Canada's Defence Department was charged with three counts of child pornography after police found more than 20,000 pornographic computer files in a government office, authorities said on Tuesday.

Blair Evans, 46, of the Ottawa suburb of Gloucester, Ontario, was charged with the creation, possession and distribution of child pornography after police raided an office at the high-security National Defence Research Establishment.
The seized files allegedly contained images of naked children and children engaging in sexual acts, and had apparently been transmitted through the Internet.

Detective Bob Matthews would not say whether more arrests were planned in connection with the case, but he said it was suspected that the Internet was used to distribute the pornography to a large international ring.
The National Defence Research Establishment develops satellite technology, communications and electronic warfare systems.
Canadian Defence Minister Doug Young said it was impossible to monitor employees' use of the Internet.

"It's not something that can be dealt with on any broad scale. There's no way you can totally guard against it unless we have Big Brother leaning over everybody in every office, in every building, in every home," he told reporters.
